item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 10 #MINPRSD
item.description:

Issued at 07:00 AM 15 November 2026

Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfTagum, SantoTomas, BraulioE.Dujali, NewCorella, Asuncion, Kapalong, SanIsidro, Talaingod), #DavaoDeOro, #DavaoOriental(Caraga, Baganga, Cateel, Boston), #SurigaoDelSur(Lingig, Hinatuan, CityOfBislig, Tagbina, Barobo), #AgusanDelSur(Loreto, LaPaz, Rosario, Bunawan, Veruela, SantaJosefa, Trento, Prosperidad, SanFrancisco), #Basilan(CityOfLamitan, Tuburan, UngkayaPukan, AlBarka, TipoTipo, HadjiMohammadAjul, Akbar), #ZamboangaCity, #NorthCotabato(Arakan, Magpet) and #Bukidnon(Kitaotao) within the next 1-2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
